name: Comet
description: A single-colour tail streams behind the pointer like a comet. The head is a bright, soft dot on the pointer and the tail thins and dims along the path, with a faint sparkle of grain drifting through it. The whole comet fades out shortly after the pointer stops.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Diameter of the head and the tail at its widest (px)

parameters.name: Tail length
parameters.description: How long a point on the path stays lit (seconds)

parameters.name: Colour
parameters.description: Colour of the head and tail

parameters.name: Sparkle
parameters.description: Amount of twinkling grain along the tail, 0 to disable
